messages.subject: Re: [R-and-cpp] sourceCpp code argument
parts:
Thanks! I just re-installed Rcpp11 and atributes and then tried the
following example and it worked:


code <- '
#include <Rcpp.h>
#include <boost/range/irange.hpp>

// [[Rcpp::depends(BH)]]

// [[Rcpp::export]]
int useCpp11() {
auto sum = 0;
for(const auto i : boost::irange(0,4)) { sum += i; }
return sum;
}
'

library(Rcpp11)
library(attributes)
sourceCpp(code = code)
useCpp11()
